direct-mid.intent: Stay together, win the shortest centre Core race, then press whichever known Core can be converted through the shortest path.
direct-mid.label: Direct Mid

distributed-wells.intent: Field a 3-3-2 economy across enemy, centre, and home Wells so all three Core streams have local workers and support.
distributed-wells.label: Distributed Wells

shadow-pincer.intent: Send two self-sufficient four-body wings through the full outer corridors, contest the enemy Well from both sides, and convert any Core either wing wins.
shadow-pincer.label: Four-plus-four Pincer

split-intercept.intent: Watch both outer corridors with paired interceptors, screen centre, and keep a home logistics pair active around the own Well.
split-intercept.label: Split Interception

evaluation.design: twelve fresh seed blocks, every unordered pair, both side assignments
evaluation.leverPolicy: Only a cross-matchup dominance alarm authorizes one minimal one-factor probe. Test a geometry-only flank timing adjustment first; change Core supply or cadence only if geometry cannot isolate the mechanism. Never rewrite a candidate inside the comparison.
evaluation.outcomesAre: a deterministic design screen over these registered seeds, not a human-fun or population claim
